aboutHero.heading: Who we are
aboutHero.body1: Bool was founded in 2013 and is part of Code For All Group. We are a boutique consulting firm that delivers custom software solutions from Portugal to the world.
aboutHero.body2: As a trusted technology partner, our experience over more than a decade in multiple sectors give us the business and technical knowledge to make a difference and generate real impact in our customers. We are a solid player in the Market and the "One Stop Shop" for their Application Development Strategy. We cover the entire application life-cycle from Ideation, to Architecture, UX/UI, Integrations, Development, Maintenance, Operation and Training.
aboutHero.mission.title: Mission
aboutHero.mission.body: Bool exists to build software that works. We want to be the reference in critical solutions, delivery, fast, reliable and driven by impact, not because we say so, but because we get it done.
aboutHero.vision.title: Vision
aboutHero.vision.body: We push business forward. Our purpose is to build real software that makes a difference. We do it by combining world-class talent across leading stacks and a relentless focus on client success. We deliver results.

caseStudies.items.1.challenge: Not being able to plan ahead the production of all grilled chicken products (whole, half, wings) and accurately serve the multiple stores according to their demand.
caseStudies.items.1.solution: The solution creates the weekly production plan for grilled chicken for all stores. Users in the Back Office input key data like article weights, batch sizes, oven types, and settings. The app then uses this intel combined with Sales Data imported via API to create a production plan for all stores.
caseStudies.items.1.benefits: Streamlines the weekly planning of grilled chicken production across multiple stores. Centralizes all production-related data like weights, batch sizes, and oven configurations. Automates complex calculations, reducing manual effort and errors. Generates a ready-to-use production plan in PDF, improving operational efficiency.
caseStudies.items.2.challenge: High volume and turnover means the cycle never stops. Large number of employees at a continuous rate makes it hard to properly onboard and support the new teams.
caseStudies.items.2.solution: The solution allows for a seamless integration with the customer HR Core Systems, like SAP HPS and SuccessFactors, making it easier for HR and all stakeholders to be in control of the business and not concerned about missing data.
caseStudies.items.2.benefits: Reduced turnover and improved retention. Faster time-to-productivity so new hires can start contributing effectively on the sales floor sooner. Cost and time savings through automation, drastically reducing the administrative burden on HR teams and managers.
caseStudies.items.3.challenge: Manual Excel-based processes for supplier negotiations and price updates were slow, error-prone, and lacked transparency. Teams faced inefficiencies, delayed communication, and limited ability to scale or react quickly to market changes.
caseStudies.items.3.solution: FreshFlow Negotiator centralizes and automates supplier negotiations, replacing Excel. It streamlines workflows, automates price updates, triggers email notifications, and provides full visibility, giving teams control, speed, and accuracy.
caseStudies.items.3.benefits: Faster, smarter negotiations with structured workflows. Accurate and consistent data through automation. Time and cost savings by reducing repetitive tasks. Better supplier collaboration with instant updates and improved communication.
caseStudies.items.4.challenge: Critical operational data was scattered across multiple databases, making it difficult to analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive continuous improvement. Teams lacked a unified view to support fast, data-driven decisions.
caseStudies.items.4.solution: LiveMast is a centralized analytics platform that consolidates dispersed data into a single hub. It calculates and analyzes key operational indicators, providing clarity on performance and enabling teams to optimize workflows across the organization.
caseStudies.items.4.benefits: Unified data visibility with all workflow data consolidated in one place. Improved decision-making with real-time insights. Higher efficiency by identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. Future-ready scalable platform for new datasets and tools.
caseStudies.items.5.challenge: Managing charge fees across multiple countries using Excel created inconsistencies, slow updates, and limited visibility. Teams needed a unified, reliable way to manage and apply fee structures efficiently.
caseStudies.items.5.solution: Tarifas App is a centralized Mendix application that streamlines the management of country-specific fees. It replaces manual spreadsheets with a secure, structured system integrated with Azure to ensure accurate, real-time fee updates.
caseStudies.items.5.benefits: Centralized fee management across all countries. Accuracy and compliance by eliminating Excel errors. Operational efficiency by streamlining updates and reducing manual work. Scalable foundation built on Mendix and Azure.
caseStudies.items.6.challenge: Managing LA Metro train data across speed, location, camera streams, GPS, and brake pressure was complex and fragmented. Operators lacked a centralized platform for monitoring and analyzing critical operational data in real time.
caseStudies.items.6.solution: LA Metro is a Mendix-based application that consolidates train data into a single platform. It integrates AI and ClickHouse to monitor speed, location, camera feeds, GPS position, and brake pressure, providing operators with actionable insights for safer and more efficient operations.
caseStudies.items.6.benefits: Centralized data monitoring with all train data in one accessible platform. Enhanced safety and efficiency with real-time insights. Operational visibility across multiple data streams simultaneously. Data-driven decisions supported by AI analytics.
caseStudies.items.7.challenge: Unpredictable and inaccurate cost forecasting for their station delivery operations. With little control over critical variables, they relied on gut instinct to estimate delivery costs.
caseStudies.items.7.solution: Allows storage and edition of fuel flow rates in pipelines, energy and component costs, and leverages historical operational data to accurately calculate cost predictions for future fuel delivery operations across every individual station.
caseStudies.items.7.benefits: Improved profit margins through accurate cost predictions and better pricing decisions. Optimized operational efficiency by understanding true cost drivers. Data-driven strategic planning for seasonal variations and long-term decisions on expansion and network optimization.
caseStudies.items.8.challenge: Return rates for online purchases can reach 20–40%, and managing this reverse logistics flow has become one of the most operationally complex and costly aspects of retail operations.
caseStudies.items.8.solution: A centralized returns processing web app with role-specific workflows for warehouse staff, front office, back office, and finance, with refund workflows and a financial dashboard for reporting and trends.
caseStudies.items.8.benefits: Faster processing by eliminating manual handoffs, reducing return-to-refund time from days to hours. Financial control with complete visibility into refund costs and fraud prevention. Inventory accuracy with real-time stock updates as returns are registered.
caseStudies.items.9.challenge: Legacy OS10 and Oracle environments constrained scalability, security, and agility. Ahold needed to modernize its platform foundation without disruption, shifting to a secure, cloud-ready operating model.
caseStudies.items.9.solution: A CloudOps/DevOps-driven transformation delivered a new OS11 platform foundation, focused on infrastructure as code, platform standardization, SSO integration, centralized secrets management, and Azure cloud hosting.
caseStudies.items.9.benefits: Cloud-ready, modern and scalable platform for long-term growth. Stronger security posture with centralized identity and access control. Operational efficiency through standardized environments and automated management. Continuity without disruption during migration.
caseStudies.items.10.challenge: Managing daily store tasks was fragmented and manual, causing inefficiencies, delayed execution, and limited visibility into employee performance. Managers struggled to assign tasks quickly and ensure consistency across locations.
caseStudies.items.10.solution: Bluebeat Pro is a mobile-first platform that allows managers to create, assign, and track tasks in real time. Employees get a simple, clear interface to complete tasks efficiently, while dashboards provide instant insights into progress and performance.
caseStudies.items.10.benefits: Boosted productivity through clear task assignments and real-time tracking. Operational efficiency as managers save time coordinating and monitoring tasks. Visibility and accountability with performance dashboards across stores. Scalable and flexible to adapt to growth and seasonal peaks.
caseStudies.items.11.challenge: Sourcing managers faced fragmented data across multiple countries, making it difficult to compare supplier prices and align on the best negotiation strategy. Manual processes delayed decisions and risked higher costs.
caseStudies.items.11.solution: Netprice is a web-based portal that ingests supplier, item, and price data from multiple countries and provides a unified comparison platform. It enables sourcing managers to identify optimal prices, collaborate across regions, and make faster, data-driven negotiation decisions.
caseStudies.items.11.benefits: Enhanced decision-making with real-time cross-country price comparisons. Operational efficiency through automated data ingestion and consolidation. Collaboration and alignment across countries to maximize purchasing power. Cost savings by helping reduce buying prices and improve margins.
caseStudies.items.12.challenge: Managing deployments across multiple production environments was manual and time-consuming. Teams struggled to ensure apps were deployed to the correct environments reliably and efficiently.
caseStudies.items.12.solution: Power Deploy is a DevOps platform that automates and schedules deployments across all production environments. It ensures that deployments are authorized, accurately targeted, and executed without manual intervention.
caseStudies.items.12.benefits: Deployment accuracy ensuring apps reach the correct environments every time. Operational efficiency through scheduling and authorization reducing manual workload. Risk reduction by minimizing errors and failed deployments. Faster delivery cycles with confidence.
caseStudies.items.13.challenge: Employees struggled with fragmented tools to register working hours, request time off, and access company information. The existing HR app lacked features and a user-friendly experience, slowing internal processes.
caseStudies.items.13.solution: Time Sheet Application is a mobile-first PWA that allows employees to log hours, manage leave requests, access company documentation, and search the employee directory, all in one intuitive platform.
caseStudies.items.13.benefits: Improved productivity enabling employees to manage HR tasks on mobile anytime. Operational efficiency with centralized time tracking and leave management. Employee engagement through access to company news and directory. Enhanced experience with a modern interface.
caseStudies.items.14.challenge: Manual client onboarding and workflows caused inefficiencies, revenue leakage, and limited scalability. The bank needed a fast, secure, standardized digital solution for employees and customers.
caseStudies.items.14.solution: In just six months, we launched three key digital portals — the Operations Portal, Client Portal, and Admin Portal — digitizing 50+ business processes, automating workflows and invoicing, and building a scalable foundation for growth.
caseStudies.items.14.benefits: Award-winning experience recognized with the OutSystems Innovation Award 2021. Automated workflows reduced manual tasks and improved employee productivity. Scalable growth with standardized, digitized processes. Revenue protection through automation minimizing errors and revenue leakage.
caseStudies.items.15.challenge: Starting a company in Portugal was slow and bureaucratic, requiring citizens to navigate complex paperwork and manual processes. The public needed a fast, secure, and simple way to register businesses.
caseStudies.items.15.solution: Empresa Online 2.0 is a web portal that enables citizens to create companies in approximately 10 minutes. The platform includes login, digital signatures, payment processing, automated notifications, PDF generation/validation, and seamless integrations.
caseStudies.items.15.benefits: Fast and simple registration with guided workflows allowing company creation in minutes. Operational efficiency with automated processes reducing administrative work. Digital transformation modernizing public services fully online. Secure and compliant with state-sponsored login and digital signatures.
caseStudies.items.16.challenge: Shoppers and staff needed a seamless experience in a technology-driven store. Traditional processes made navigation, purchase, and payment slower, while staff had limited visibility to support customers efficiently.
caseStudies.items.16.solution: Pingo Doce Express consists of three applications (two mobile, one traditional) that allow shoppers to enter, navigate, buy, pay, and exit the store effortlessly. Staff and security can monitor activity, while the backoffice enables detailed logging and configuration.
caseStudies.items.16.benefits: Frictionless shopping with faster, smoother, and more digital transactions. Operational visibility for staff to monitor and assist in real time. Advanced backoffice with detailed logging and configurations. Innovative retail technology for a next-generation shopping experience.
caseStudies.items.17.challenge: Manually routing orders between third-party sources, manufacturers, and distributors creates delays, misallocations, and wasted capacity due to lack of automation and real-time coordination across the fulfillment network.
caseStudies.items.17.solution: An automated platform that receives orders from external sources and assigns them to the optimal manufacturer based on product type, location, capacity, and delivery time — then coordinates production and distributor logistics end-to-end.
caseStudies.items.17.benefits: Faster fulfillment through automated order routing eliminating manual coordination delays. Optimized capacity with intelligent manufacturer selection maximizing utilization. Reduced operational costs by cutting administrative overhead and minimizing errors.
caseStudies.items.18.challenge: ABB's order management relies on fragmented systems and scattered data, making reporting and auditing manual, time-consuming, and error-prone. Teams lack visibility into order status, and auditors struggle to access accurate information.
caseStudies.items.18.solution: A centralized digital platform that consolidates all order data into a single system, streamlining order management and providing easy access to accurate information for reporting and auditing across ABB.
caseStudies.items.18.benefits: Improved accuracy by centralizing data and eliminating inconsistencies. Faster auditing and reporting with consolidated access to order data. Operational efficiency through streamlined order management and reduced administrative burden.
caseStudies.items.19.challenge: Tracking project expenses manually was time-consuming, error-prone, and lacked real-time visibility. Teams struggled to control budgets, categorize costs accurately, and report financial activities efficiently.
caseStudies.items.19.solution: Helpo Project Management is a mobile platform built with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI that allows users to record expenses, categorize costs, set budgets, and monitor spending in real time.
caseStudies.items.19.benefits: Real-time financial tracking across multiple projects. Budget control with cost categorization and accurate financial management. Operational efficiency through automated expense recording and reporting. Enhanced visibility with dashboards and analytics for informed decisions.
caseStudies.items.20.challenge: Processing invoices manually was slow, error-prone, and lacked centralized control. Teams struggled with timely approvals, data accuracy, and visibility across financial processes.
caseStudies.items.20.solution: The Invoice Approval System is a mobile platform built on Power Platform that automates invoice processing. Emails are ingested, key data is extracted into Microsoft Dataverse, and an intelligent approval workflow allows designated users to review, approve, or reject invoices efficiently.
caseStudies.items.20.benefits: Automated invoice processing reducing manual data entry and errors. Faster approvals through a streamlined workflow. Data accuracy with centralized storage in Microsoft Dataverse ensuring auditable records. Teams save time and focus on higher-value tasks.
caseStudies.items.21.challenge: Parents of infants and toddlers with behavioral and developmental challenges lack timely, personalized, science-backed guidance. Generic resources and infrequent pediatrician visits leave them overwhelmed and uncertain, potentially delaying critical early interventions.
caseStudies.items.21.solution: Providing personalized, science-backed care through medical-certified assessment forms, dynamic screening, live chat support, and tailored resources to guide parents through their child's growth.
caseStudies.items.21.benefits: Improved accuracy with centralized data for reliable decision-making. Faster access to support for parents and caregivers. Operational efficiency reducing the administrative burden on healthcare teams. Better outcomes through timely and personalized guidance.
caseStudies.items.22.challenge: Healthcare teams can't quickly access current clinical protocols and best practices during patient care due to fragmented information across multiple systems, leading to inconsistent treatment, inefficient workflows, and compliance gaps.
caseStudies.items.22.solution: A centralized platform with AI assistant that delivers relevant clinical protocols and best practices to healthcare teams at the point of care, with policy management, compliance tracking, and integration into existing workflows and electronic health records.
caseStudies.items.22.benefits: Improved patient care with instant access to evidence-based protocols. Operational efficiency with automated policy updates and compliance tracking. Better clinical collaboration with centralized knowledge sharing and AI-assisted guidance.
caseStudies.items.23.challenge: Capturing, structuring, and executing project ideas was slow and fragmented. Teams relied on scattered documents and manual processes, leading to inconsistent requirements, misalignment across business and IT, and delayed execution.
caseStudies.items.23.solution: Blueprint is an AI-powered platform that automates project scoping, generating requirements, use cases, risks, user stories, and test cases, while a centralized workspace connects business, IT, and delivery teams, with Jira, Azure Boards, and Trello integrations.
caseStudies.items.23.benefits: Faster ideation-to-execution with projects moving from idea to validated scope in days. Reduced manual effort as AI automatically generates requirements and test cases. Improved collaboration with a centralized workspace aligning business and IT. Consistent, traceable documentation ensuring governance and compliance.
